n1.speaker: zara
n1.text: Hello, Customer Service desk. Oh, it's you! What's in the box?

translations.fa: سلام، میز خدمات مشتری. اوه، تویی! تو جعبه چیه؟

branches.suggestion: I'd like to return this kettle, please.
branches.suggestionFa: می‌خوام این کتری را پس بدم، لطفاً.

branches.suggestion: This kettle doesn't work. I bought it last week.
branches.suggestionFa: این کتری کار نمی‌کنه. هفتهٔ پیش خریدمش.

n2.speaker: zara
n2.text: Oh dear. What's wrong with it? Does it not turn on?

translations.fa: ای وای. چه مشکلی داره؟ روشن نمیشه؟

branches.suggestion: It turns on, but it doesn't switch off!
It leaks. There's water all over the counter.
branches.suggestionFa: نشتی داره. همه‌جای کابینت آب میشه.

recasts.echo: It doesn't switch off? That's dangerous!

n3.speaker: zara
n3.text: That's not safe at all. Have you got the receipt? Paper, or on the app?

translations.fa: این اصلاً امن نیست. رسیدش را داری؟ کاغذی یا تو اپ؟

branches.suggestion: Here's the receipt. I kept it.
I scanned my Superstore card. Is that enough?
branches.suggestionFa: کارت سوپراستورم را اسکن کردم. کافیه؟

cultureNote.en: In the UK you can return faulty items for a refund. Most shops also accept unwanted items within about 30 days with a receipt.
cultureNote.fa: کالای معیوب را می‌توان پس داد و پول گرفت.

n4.speaker: zara
n4.text: Perfect, I can find it on your card. Bought on the third, nineteen ninety-nine. Would you like a refund or an exchange?

translations.fa: عالیه، از روی کارتت پیداش می‌کنم. خرید سوم ماه، نوزده و نود و نه. پولت را پس می‌خوای یا تعویض؟

branches.suggestion: A refund, please. I'll buy a better one.
branches.suggestionFa: پس دادن پول، لطفاً. یه بهترش می‌خرم.

branches.suggestion: An exchange. The same kettle, but working!

n5.speaker: zara
n5.text: No problem. It goes back to the card you paid with. Can you tap that card here? It takes three to five days.

translations.fa: مشکلی نیست. پول به همون کارتی که باهاش پرداختی برمی‌گرده. میشه کارت را اینجا بزنی؟ سه تا پنج روز طول می‌کشه.

branches.suggestion: Three to five days? Not today?
branches.suggestionFa: سه تا پنج روز؟ امروز نه؟

branches.suggestion: I paid with my phone. Is that OK?
branches.suggestionFa: با گوشیم پرداخت کردم. اشکالی نداره؟

n6.speaker: zara
n6.text: Phone's fine, tap it the same way. Banks are slow, sorry — but you'll see it by Friday. Here's your refund receipt.

translations.fa: گوشی خوبه، همون‌طوری بزن. بانک‌ها کندن، ببخشید — ولی تا جمعه می‌بینیش. این رسید بازپرداختته.

branches.suggestion: Thank you. Can I return these shoes too?
branches.suggestionFa: ممنون. این کفش‌ها را هم می‌تونم پس بدم؟

n7.speaker: zara
n7.text: Have they been worn? If they're unworn, in the box, with the tag, yes. If you've worn them in the rain… that's harder!

translations.fa: پوشیده شدن؟ اگه پوشیده نشدن، تو جعبه، با برچسب، آره. اگه زیر بارون پوشیدیشون… اون سخت‌تره!

branches.suggestion: They're unworn. Still in the box.

n8.speaker: zara
n8.text: Ha! I'll pretend I didn't hear that. They look perfect. Refund done. You're a returns expert now!

translations.fa: ها! وانمود می‌کنم نشنیدم. بی‌نقص به نظر میان. پول برگشت. الان دیگه متخصص مرجوعی هستی!
